summary.en: A title enters unit by unit — words, Chinese phrases or characters — each unit travelling the same short way, staggered; seven ways to travel.
summary.zh: 标题按单位逐个入场（英文按词或字母，中文按词组或单字），每个单位走同一段短路、错峰；七种走法。

fits: The first appearance of a title, a claim or a section heading on a still ground: blur is the quiet default for most titles, rise, press, drift, drop, path and tumble are livelier ways (tumble: the words of a page assembling after its shapes).
notFor: Text already on screen or already read (re-entering reads as a stutter); more than two lines; more than two kinds of title entrance in a film, and drift, drop or path more than once.

intent.en: The title arrives piece by piece in reading order, so the viewer reads it as it lands; blur stays out of the way, the other ways make the arrival an event.
intent.zh: 标题按阅读顺序一块块到位，观众边落边读；blur 不抢戏，其余几种把入场本身做成一件事。

content.en: One or two lines of title (≤ 40 chars a line), an optional accent word and an optional sub line; for path, a curve that means something (a growth line).
content.zh: 一到两行标题（每行 ≤ 18 字），可选一个强调词和一行副标题；path 式还要一条有含义的曲线（如增长线）。

fits.zh: 标题、主张或小节标题在安静画面上第一次出现：blur 是多数标题的安静默认，rise、press、drift、drop、path、tumble 更活泼（tumble 适合页面拼好形状后文字落位）。

notFor.zh: 已经在画面上或已读过的字（再入场像口吃）；超过两行；一支片超过两种标题入场，drift、drop、path 各超过一次。

pairs.note: mark the key word once the title has landed

en: At most two kinds of title entrance per film, counting type-retype and write-on; use blur for every title but the hero.
Chinese must be split by meaning into 3–5 phrases, not into single characters.
Over about 8 words, shorten the gap between words or the last one enters during the hold.
Keep the camera still while drift, drop or path is flying; drop wants words without descenders (g, j, p, q, y).
zh: 连同 type-retype、write-on，一支片标题入场最多两种；主角以外的标题一律用 blur。
中文按语义切成 3–5 个词组，别退化成逐字。
超过约 8 个词就压短词间隔，否则末词挤到收尾停留里才进。
drift、drop、path 飞行时镜头必须稳；drop 避开带下行笔画的字母（g、j、p、q、y）。

upstream.name: 逐词模糊入场
upstream.summary: 标题逐词入场，y 0.38em→0 + blur 18→0 + opacity 0→1 三通道走同一条 ease-out 同步收敛，词间隔约 4f；副标题在标题收完前就错峰跟进
upstream.use: 几乎所有标题/副标题成对出现的场合；产品页首屏文案、章节小标题；需要"专业但不抢戏"的默认文字 reveal
upstream.energy: 低（一次性收敛，无峰值无循环）

upstream.name: 逐字裂升
upstream.summary: 每字 overflow 盒内 translateY(115%→0) 带 10% 过冲，delay i×2f，基线同步生长
upstream.use: 大标题/标语的入场；与 type-entrance-moves、document-typewriter-reveal 同属标题入场大品类，全片 ≤2 种
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 中高 / C 中

upstream.name: 纸张标题卡
upstream.summary: 一句话逐词压印上纸、一个词标强调色斜体、短划线收束
upstream.use: 章节转场/价值主张字卡；重要功能出场前的引导卡；全片呼吸位
upstream.energy: 低（呼吸位，隔开两段高能镜头）

upstream.name: 漂移合拢
upstream.summary: 字符 seed 方向 ±300px + blur 8px 漂入错峰归位，锁定帧加深脉冲，合体后整词呼吸 1.04
upstream.use: 大标题/标语的入场；与 type-entrance-moves、document-typewriter-reveal 同属标题入场大品类，全片 ≤2 种
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 中高 / C 中

upstream.name: 字符坠落
upstream.summary: 标题文字入场一式——letter-drop-physics 字符坠落（重力砸落、弹跳、歪斜站定，最后一拍集体立正归位）
upstream.use: 大标题/章节字卡的入场；与 type-assembly-moves（集结系）、document-typewriter-reveal（打字机）同品类互斥选用

upstream.name: 沿线流入
upstream.summary: 字符沿贝塞尔曲线鱼贯滑入（切线角旋转），到达后 12f 摆正水平
upstream.use: 大标题/标语的入场；与 type-entrance-moves、document-typewriter-reveal 同属标题入场大品类，全片 ≤2 种
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 中高 / C 中

upstream.name: 骨架装配落字
upstream.summary: 空的暗底网格上，无文字的组件骨架先从四面八方飞入贴合；随后各处文字逐字从 3D 空间旋转着飞来落位，先大标题后小标注，全部落位后页面成形
upstream.use: 页面/海报"自己长出来"的开场；排版类产品的能力展示；从骨架到成稿的两段式叙事
upstream.energy: 中高（骨架段稀疏、文字段密集，能量单调上升到收尾）

overlaps.note: path-type swaps two sentences through a loop of the line; type-enter path brings one title in along a curve
a line resolving in reading order through scrambled glyphs, for ids and hashes
lead-word shows the first word alone at 2.3× and builds the line round it; type-enter gives every unit the same short way
a line typed with a visible correction; type-enter has no correction to make
